gloss: to take a walk; to go for a stroll

definitions.gloss: to take a walk; to go for a stroll
definitions.explanation: To walk leisurely for relaxation, exercise, or enjoyment rather than to reach a specific destination. A common daily activity in Japan, especially for the elderly and dog owners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{散歩|さんぽ}する。
examples.english: To take a walk in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{散歩|さんぽ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I go for a walk with my dog every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{散歩|さんぽ}する⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Taking a short walk after eating is good for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{川沿|かわぞ}い→川沿い：03046_kawazoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{散歩|さんぽ}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: On days off, I enjoy walking along the riverside path.

notes:
One of the most common daily activities mentioned in Japanese conversation. Taking a ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧ is considered both a health practice and a form of relaxation. The particle used with locations varies: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{散歩|さんぽ}する (through/around a park) or ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{散歩|さんぽ}する (at a park).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧: morning walk
- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧: walking the dog
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}{道|みち}→散歩道：23492_sanpomichi⟧: walking path
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧: walking route
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go for a walk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk — neutral verb for the physical action of walking
- ⟦ウォーキング→ウォーキング：05240_wookingu⟧: walking (exercise) — implies deliberate exercise with health goals
- ⟦{徘徊|はいかい}→徘徊：09037_haikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to wander — aimless walking, sometimes with negative connotation
